key_highlights: ASX shed $90b in a week amid rate-rise fears and oil surge, but edged higher on the day as oil slid (1, 63)
Iron ore in freefall — 'the crash is here' — pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG materially (4, 68)
US 10-year Treasury yield at 4.94% despite $5.2B buyback; Fed rate hike likely this week on hot inflation (22, 45)
Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c/litre on global oil 'deadly cocktail' (61)
ANZ completes 3,500-job axe; restructuring plan still has long runway (54)
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals sector stress (64)
Housing: no spring bounce in auctions; house-price correction questions persist (32, 53)
Santos preservation deemed a national sacrifice, reshaping energy landscape (66)
AI/tech momentum continues globally; Hut 8 stake increase by Third Point signals crypto-mining interest (48, 50)

sectors.trend: Severely negative. Iron ore in confirmed crash phase; cap-raise activity surging as juniors seek liquidity. Gold underperforming ('gold schmould').
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Canaccord-led cap raises (64) signal distress. Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources, PolarX (58) show selective small-cap resilience. Avoid large-cap iron ore exposure short-term.

sectors.trend: Mixed. ANZ.AX restructuring underway post 3,500-job cut. Rising 10Y yield (4.94%) pressures bond portfolios but supports NIMs. Superannuation system under political scrutiny.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX benefit from wider spreads but face credit-risk questions if housing correction deepens. ANZ.AX execution risk on cost plan. Super fund flows may face political headwinds (56, 65).

sectors.trend: Oil spike pressuring input costs; Santos preservation reshapes domestic gas/LNG supply. Fuel prices rising 30c.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX strategically important but politically constrained. Woodside.AX, AGL.AX, Origin.AX face cost-pass-through pressure. Airlines (QAN.AX, SYD.AX) squeezed by fuel + staff shortages (35, 59).

sectors.trend: Weak. 49-year clothing chain closing stores; jewelry chain shutting 53 stores. Consumer spending under pressure from fuel and tax burden.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX (retail banking), and listed retailers face softening footfall. Defensive consumer staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) relatively resilient but not immune.

sectors.trend: Globally bullish. AI capex cycle intact; Hut 8 stake increase, NVIDIA/Digital Realty expansion, Alibaba $10.2B AI test. ASX small-caps (Iondrive, Neurizon) gaining momentum.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed AI/tech names (NEU.AX, ION.AX) benefit from global sentiment. Data centre power demand in QLD (25) supports energy infrastructure plays. Musk robot-economy narrative (40) a longer-term theme.

sectors.trend: Negative. No auction bounce; house-price correction questions; NZ correction still running. Political pressure on super and housing policy.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and yield risk. Residential builders (WBC.AX construction, MIR.AX) under pressure. Monitor RBA response to housing data.

key_themes: Iron ore crash and mining sector stress
Global rate-hike cycle (Fed, 10Y at 4.94%) pressuring risk assets
Oil/fuel cost shock hitting Australian consumers and airlines
AI/tech capex supercycle vs. doomsday warnings
Housing correction and superannuation political risk
China geopolitical pivot affecting commodity demand
Mining cap-raise wave signalling liquidity stress

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold or diversified miners; hedge with commodity futures

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed rate hike / global yield spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration; favour floating-rate credit; monitor AUD/USD for sharp depreciation
Underweight airlines (QAN.AX, SYD.AX); favour energy producers with hedged output
Reduce REIT and residential builder exposure; monitor RBA policy response
Diversify away from China-exposed commodity names; monitor Arctic shipping route implications

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Political risk to superannuation and migration policy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor policy announcements; avoid over-concentration in super-dependent REITs

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight AI/tech and data-centre infrastructure plays
opportunities.rationale: Global AI capex cycle intact; ASX small-caps (Iondrive, Neurizon) showing relative strength; QLD data centre demand supports energy infrastructure

opportunities.recommendation: Selective mining exposure via gold and diversified names
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore crash hurts pure-plays; gold underperforming but may stabilise; cap-raise stress creates entry points for quality juniors
Retail weakness (clothing, jewelry closures) favours essential-goods names; fuel cost shock supports value-oriented consumption

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap iron ore and China-exposed materials
defensive_moves.rationale: Confirmed iron ore crash; China demand pivot risk; cap-raise wave signals sector-wide stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim REIT and residential builder exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: No auction bounce; house-price correction questions; NZ correction still running; political risk to housing policy

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and reduce rate-sensitive duration
defensive_moves.rationale: Fed hike likely; 10Y at 4.94%; ASX already shed $90b; further global risk-off possible

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. ASX faces headwinds from iron ore crash, Fed hike, oil shock, and housing weakness. $90b weekly loss signals stress. Day-to-day bounces (oil slide) offer tactical entries but trend is down. 10Y yield at 4.94% caps multiples.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle, energy transition, and mining cap-raise consolidation create medium-term opportunities. Housing correction may stabilise by H2 2027. Superannuation system reform risk is a tail risk. China pivot is the key wildcard.
key_catalysts: Iron ore price floor / China demand data (4, 68)
RBA response to housing and inflation data
watch_list: China trade policy / Arctic shipping developments
